│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  CPU-friendly mask conversion and deterministic non-overlap post-processing  │
│  for pathology cell masks.                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│  This version uses PIL (Pillow) for rasterization and a convex-hull-based    │
│  approach to derive a single                                                 │
│  non-overlapping contour per mask. It handles both rectangle and polyline    │
│  inputs and clamps coordinates.                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Usage:                                                                      │

│  def try_import_mobile_sam() -&gt; bool:                                     │

│  def parse_coords_list(s: str) -&gt; List[int]:                              │
│      if s is None:                                                           │
│          return []                                                           │
│      s = s.strip()                                                           │
│      if not s:                                                               │
│          return []                                                           │
│      parts = [p.strip() for p in s.split(&#x27;,&#x27;) if p.strip() !=      │
│  &#x27;&#x27;]                                                               │
│      coords: List[int] = []                                                  │
│      for p in parts:                                                         │
│          try:                                                                │
│              coords.append(int(p))                                           │
│          except ValueError:                                                  │
│              pass                                                            │
│      return coords                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│  def clamp_point(pt: Tuple[int, int], width: int, height: int) -&gt;         │
│  Tuple[int, int]:                                                            │
│      x, y = pt                                                               │
│      x = max(0, min(width - 1, int(x)))                                      │
│      y = max(0, min(height - 1, int(y)))                                     │
│      return x, y                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def ensure_closed(poly: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; List[Tuple[int,int]]:   │
│      if len(poly) == 0:                                                      │
│          return poly                                                         │
│      if poly[0] != poly[-1]:                                                 │
│          poly = poly + [poly[0]]                                             │
│      return poly                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def polyline_to_mask(poly: List[Tuple[int,int]], width: int, height: int)   │
│  -&gt; np.ndarray:                                                           │
│      if len(poly) &lt; 3:                                                    │
│          return np.zeros((height, width), dtype=np.uint8)                    │
│      img = Image.new(&#x27;L&#x27;, (width, height), 0)                      │
│      draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)                                              │
│      draw.polygon(poly, fill=1)                                              │
│      return np.array(img, dtype=np.uint8)                                    │
│                                                                              │
│  def convex_hull(points: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; List[Tuple[int,int]]:   │
│      pts = sorted(set(points))                                               │
│      if len(pts) &lt;= 1:                                                    │
│          return pts                                                          │
│      def cross(o, a, b):                                                     │
│          return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1]) - (a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])            │
│      lower = []                                                              │
│      for p in pts:                                                           │
│          while len(lower) &gt;= 2 and cross(lower[-2], lower[-1], p) &lt;=   │
│  0:                                                                          │
│              lower.pop()                                                     │
│          lower.append(p)                                                     │
│      upper = []                                                              │
│      for p in reversed(pts):                                                 │
│          while len(upper) &gt;= 2 and cross(upper[-2], upper[-1], p) &lt;=   │
│  0:                                                                          │
│              upper.pop()                                                     │
│          upper.append(p)                                                     │
│      hull = lower[:-1] + upper[:-1]                                          │
│      if len(hull) &gt; 0 and hull[0] != hull[-1]:                            │
│          hull.append(hull[0])                                                │
│      return hull                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def contour_area(poly: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; float:                   │
│      if len(poly) &lt; 3:                                                    │
│          return 0.0                                                          │
│      area = 0.0                                                              │
│      for i in range(len(poly)):                                              │
│          x1, y1 = poly[i]                                                    │
│          x2, y2 = poly[(i+1) % len(poly)]                                    │
│          area += x1*y2 - x2*y1                                               │
│      return abs(area) / 2.0                                                  │

│     • Sorts masks by their approximate polygon area (largest first).         │
│     • Rasterizes each polyline to a binary mask on a canvas sized to the     │
│       image.                                                                 │
│     • Subtracts already-occupied pixels to enforce non-overlap.              │
│     • If there is non-overlap, extracts the largest connected                │
│       non-overlapping region, computes its convex hull, and uses that as the │
│       final polyline.                                                        │
│     • If no non-overlapping region is available, progressively shrinks the   │
│       polygon around its centroid (factors 0.8, 0.6, 0.4) and retries.       │

│       polyline.                                                              │

│  def convex_hull(points: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; List[Tuple[int,int]]:   │

│  0:                                                                          │

│  #!/usr/bin/env python3                                                      │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  CPU-only PIL-based convert and non-overlap post-processing for              │
│  histopathology masks.                                                       │
│  - Handles both rectangle (bbox) and polyline-encoded masks from a CSV with  │
│  a leading unnamed column.                                                   │
│  - Converts all masks to polylines, enforces non-overlap deterministically,  │
│  and writes updated CSV.                                                     │
│  - Uses only numpy and Pillow (no OpenCV required).                          │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│                                                                              │
│  import os                                                                   │
│  import csv                                                                  │
│  import sys                                                                  │
│  import argparse                                                             │
│  from typing import List, Tuple                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  import numpy as np                                                          │
│  from PIL import Image, ImageDraw                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  def parse_coords_list(s: str) -&gt; List[int]:                              │
│      if s is None:                                                           │
│          return []                                                           │
│      s = s.strip()                                                           │
│      if not s:                                                               │
│          return []                                                           │
│      parts = [p.strip() for p in s.split(&#x27;,&#x27;) if p.strip() !=      │
│  &#x27;&#x27;]                                                               │
│      coords: List[int] = []                                                  │
│      for p in parts:                                                         │
│          try:                                                                │
│              coords.append(int(p))                                           │
│          except ValueError:                                                  │
│              pass                                                            │
│      return coords                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│  def clamp_point(pt: Tuple[int, int], width: int, height: int) -&gt;         │
│  Tuple[int, int]:                                                            │
│      x, y = pt                                                               │
│      x = max(0, min(width - 1, int(x)))                                      │
│      y = max(0, min(height - 1, int(y)))                                     │
│      return x, y                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def ensure_closed(poly: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; List[Tuple[int,int]]:   │
│      if len(poly) == 0:                                                      │
│          return poly                                                         │
│      if poly[0] != poly[-1]:                                                 │
│          poly = poly + [poly[0]]                                             │
│      return poly                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def polyline_to_mask(poly: List[Tuple[int,int]], width: int, height: int)   │
│  -&gt; np.ndarray:                                                           │
│      if len(poly) &lt; 3:                                                    │
│          return np.zeros((height, width), dtype=np.uint8)                    │
│      img = Image.new(&#x27;L&#x27;, (width, height), 0)                      │
│      draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)                                              │
│      draw.polygon(poly, fill=1)                                              │
│      return np.array(img, dtype=np.uint8)                                    │
│                                                                              │
│  def convex_hull(points: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; List[Tuple[int,int]]:   │
│      pts = sorted(set(points))                                               │
│      if len(pts) &lt;= 1:                                                    │
│          return pts                                                          │
│      def cross(o, a, b):                                                     │
│          return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1]) - (a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])            │
│      lower = []                                                              │
│      for p in pts:                                                           │
│          while len(lower) &gt;= 2 and cross(lower[-2], lower[-1], p) &lt;=   │
│  0:                                                                          │
│              lower.pop()                                                     │
│          lower.append(p)                                                     │
│      upper = []                                                              │
│      for p in reversed(pts):                                                 │
│          while len(upper) &gt;= 2 and cross(upper[-2], upper[-1], p) &lt;=   │
│  0:                                                                          │
│              upper.pop()                                                     │
│          upper.append(p)                                                     │
│      hull = lower[:-1] + upper[:-1]                                          │
│      if len(hull) &gt; 0 and hull[0] != hull[-1]:                            │
│          hull.append(hull[0])                                                │
│      return hull                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│  def contour_area(poly: List[Tuple[int,int]]) -&gt; float:                   │
│      if len(poly) &lt; 3:                                                    │
│          return 0.0                                                          │
│      area = 0.0                                                              │
│      for i in range(len(poly)):                                              │
│          x1, y1 = poly[i]                                                    │
│          x2, y2 = poly[(i+1) % len(poly)]                                    │
│          area += x1*y2 - x2*y1                                               │
│      return abs(area) / 2.0                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│  def read_input_csv(csv_path: str):                                          │
│      with open(csv_path, &#x27;r&#x27;, newline=&#x27;&#x27;) as f:          │
│          reader = csv.DictReader(f)                                          │
│          fieldnames = reader.fieldnames if reader.fieldnames is not None     │
│  else []                                                                     │
│          rows = [dict(r) for r in reader]                                    │
│      return fieldnames, rows                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│  def write_output_csv(fieldnames, rows, out_csv):                            │
│      os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_csv), exist_ok=True)                    │
│      with open(out_csv, &#x27;w&#x27;, newline=&#x27;&#x27;) as f:           │
│          w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames)                        │
│          w.writeheader()                                                     │
│          for r in rows:                                                      │
│              w.writerow(r)                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│  def main():                                                                 │
│      parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()                                      │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;weights_path&#x27;)                           │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;output_path&#x27;)                            │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;rgb_path&#x27;)                               │
│      parser.add_argument(&#x27;csv_path&#x27;)                               │
│      args = parser.parse_args()                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      output_dir = args.output_path                                           │
│      os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)                                  │
│      out_csv_path = os.path.join(output_dir, &#x27;refined_masks.csv&#x27;)  │
│                                                                              │
│      # Load image size                                                       │
│      from PIL import Image                                                   │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          with Image.open(args.rgb_path) as img:                              │
│              width, height = img.size                                        │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          print(f&quot;ERROR: could not read image {args.rgb_path}:           │
│  {e}&quot;)                                                                  │
│          sys.exit(2)                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      fieldnames, rows = read_input_csv(args.csv_path)                        │
│      if not rows:                                                            │
│          print(&quot;WARNING: input CSV has no rows; writing empty           │
│  output.&quot;)                                                              │
│          write_output_csv(fieldnames, [], out_csv_path)                      │
│          sys.exit(0)                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      # Prepare initial polylines and area for sorting                        │
│      initial_polys: List[List[Tuple[int,int]]] = []                          │
│      areas: List[float] = []                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│      for row in rows:                                                        │
│          try:                                                                │
│              xmin = int(float(row.get(&#x27;xmin&#x27;, &#x27;0&#x27;)))     │
│              ymin = int(float(row.get(&#x27;ymin&#x27;, &#x27;0&#x27;)))     │
│              xmax = int(float(row.get(&#x27;xmax&#x27;, str(width-1))))      │
│              ymax = int(float(row.get(&#x27;ymax&#x27;, str(height-1))))     │
│          except Exception:                                                   │
│              xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax = 0, 0, width-1, height-1                │
│          t = (row.get(&#x27;type&#x27;, &#x27;&#x27;) or                     │
│  &#x27;&#x27;).lower()                                                       │
│          coords_x = parse_coords_list(row.get(&#x27;coords_x&#x27;,          │
│  &#x27;&#x27;))                                                              │
│          coords_y = parse_coords_list(row.get(&#x27;coords_y&#x27;,          │
│  &#x27;&#x27;))                                                              │
│          poly: List[Tuple[int,int]] = []                                     │
│          if t == &#x27;rectangle&#x27;:                                      │
│              poly = [(xmin, ymin), (xmax, ymin), (xmax, ymax), (xmin,        │
│  ymax), (xmin, ymin)]                                                        │
│          else:                                                               │
│              if len(coords_x) == len(coords_y) and len(coords_x) &gt;= 2:    │
│                  poly = [(coords_x[i], coords_y[i]) for i in                 │
│  range(len(coords_x))]                                                       │
│                  if poly[0] != poly[-1]:                                     │
│                      poly.append(poly[0])                                    │
│              else:                                                           │
│                  poly = [(xmin, ymin), (xmax, ymin), (xmax, ymax), (xmin,    │
│  ymax), (xmin, ymin)]                                                        │
│          poly = [ (max(0, min(width-1, int(px))), max(0, min(height-1,       │
│  int(py)))) for (px,py) in poly ]                                            │
│          if len(poly) == 0:                                                  │
│              poly = [(0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(0,1),(0,0)]                          │
│          initial_polys.append(poly)                                          │
│          areas.append(contour_area(poly))                                    │
│                                                                              │
│      idxs = list(range(len(rows)))                                           │
│      idxs.sort(key=lambda i: areas[i], reverse=True)                         │
│                                                                              │
│      occ = np.zeros((height, width), dtype=np.uint8)                         │
│      final_polys = [None] * len(rows)  # type: ignore                        │
│      skipped = 0                                                             │
│                                                                              │
│      for idx in idxs:                                                        │
│          poly = initial_polys[idx]                                           │
│          if len(poly) &lt; 3:                                                │
│              final_polys[idx] = poly                                         │
│              continue                                                        │
│          mask = polyline_to_mask(poly, width, height)                        │
│          non_overlap = mask &amp; (~occ)                                     │
│          placed = False                                                      │
│          if int((non_overlap &gt; 0).sum()) &gt; 0:                          │
│              occ = occ | non_overlap                                         │
│              pts = [(int(p[0]), int(p[1])) for p in np.argwhere(non_overlap  │
│  &gt; 0)]                                                                    │
│              if len(pts) &gt;= 3:                                            │
│                  hull = convex_hull(pts)                                     │
│                  hull = ensure_closed(hull)                                  │
│                  hull = [ (max(0, min(width-1, int(x))), max(0,              │
│  min(height-1, int(y)))) for (x,y) in hull ]                                 │
│                  final_polys[idx] = hull                                     │
│                  placed = True                                               │
│          if not placed:                                                      │
│              cx = sum(p[0] for p in poly) / len(poly)                        │
│              cy = sum(p[1] for p in poly) / len(poly)                        │
│              for factor in (0.8, 0.6, 0.4):                                  │
│                  shrunk = [ (int(round(cx + (p[0]-cx)*factor)),              │
│  int(round(cy + (p[1]-cy)*factor))) for p in poly ]                          │
│                  shrunk = [ clamp_point(p, width, height) for p in shrunk ]  │
│                  if len(shrunk) &lt; 3:                                      │
│                      continue                                                │
│                  m2 = polyline_to_mask(shrunk, width, height)                │
│                  non_overlap2 = m2 &amp; (~occ)                              │
│                  if int((non_overlap2 &gt; 0).sum()) &gt; 0:                 │
│                      occ = occ | non_overlap2                                │
│                      pts2 = [(int(p[0]), int(p[1])) for p in                 │
│  np.argwhere(non_overlap2 &gt; 0)]                                           │
│                      if len(pts2) &gt;= 3:                                   │
│                          hull2 = convex_hull(pts2)                           │
│                          hull2 = ensure_closed(hull2)                        │
│                          hull2 = [ (max(0, min(width-1, int(x))), max(0,     │
│  min(height-1, int(y)))) for (x,y) in hull2 ]                                │
│                          final_polys[idx] = hull2                            │
│                          placed = True                                       │
│                          break                                               │
│              if not placed:                                                  │
│                  cx_i, cy_i = int(round(cx)), int(round(cy))                 │
│                  ph = [(cx_i-1, cy_i-1), (cx_i+1, cy_i-1), (cx_i+1,          │
│  cy_i+1), (cx_i-1, cy_i+1), (cx_i-1, cy_i-1)]                                │
│                  ph = [ clamp_point(p, width, height) for p in ph ]          │
│                  final_polys[idx] = ph                                       │
│                  skipped += 1                                                │
│                                                                              │
│      new_rows = []                                                           │
│      for i, row in enumerate(rows):                                          │
│          poly = final_polys[i]                                               │
│          if poly is None:                                                    │
│              poly = initial_polys[i]                                         │
│          poly = ensure_closed(poly)                                          │
│          if len(poly) == 0:                                                  │
│              poly = [(0,0),(1,0),(1,1),(0,1),(0,0)]                          │
│          xs = [p[0] for p in poly]                                           │
│          ys = [p[1] for p in poly]                                           │
│          if xs:                                                              │
│              xmin, xmax = min(xs), max(xs)                                   │
│          else:                                                               │
│              xmin, xmax = 0, 0                                               │
│          if ys:                                                              │
│              ymin, ymax = min(ys), max(ys)                                   │
│          else:                                                               │
│              ymin, ymax = 0, 0                                               │
│          xmin = max(0, min(width-1, int(xmin)))                              │
│          ymin = max(0, min(height-1, int(ymin)))                             │
│          xmax = max(0, min(width-1, int(xmax)))                              │
│          ymax = max(0, min(height-1, int(ymax)))                             │
│          row_out = dict(row)                                                 │
│          row_out[&#x27;xmin&#x27;] = int(xmin)                               │
│          row_out[&#x27;ymin&#x27;] = int(ymin)                               │
│          row_out[&#x27;xmax&#x27;] = int(xmax)                               │
│          row_out[&#x27;ymax&#x27;] = int(ymax)                               │
│          row_out[&#x27;coords_x&#x27;] = &#x27;,&#x27;.join(str(int(p[0]))   │
│  for p in poly)                                                              │
│          row_out[&#x27;coords_y&#x27;] = &#x27;,&#x27;.join(str(int(p[1]))   │
│  for p in poly)                                                              │
│          row_out[&#x27;type&#x27;] = &#x27;polyline&#x27;                    │
│          new_rows.append(row_out)                                            │
│                                                                              │
│      write_output_csv(fieldnames, new_rows, out_csv_path)                    │
│      print(&quot;Refinement complete.&quot;)                                 │
│      print(f&quot;Input rows: {len(rows)}; Output rows:                      │
│  {len(new_rows)}&quot;)                                                      │
│      print(f&quot;Skipped/placeholders: {skipped}&quot;)                     │
│      print(f&quot;Output written to: {out_csv_path}&quot;)                   │
│                                                                              │
│  if __name__ == &#x27;__main__&#x27;:                                        │
│      main()                                                                  │

│        • Each mask is rasterized to a binary mask (PIL).                     │
│        • Non-overlapping regions are extracted via a convex hull of the      │
│          non-overlapping pixels.                                             │
│        • If no non-overlapping region can be allocated, it shrinks around    │
│          the centroid (factors 0.8, 0.6, 0.4) and retries.                   │
│        • If still not possible, a small centroid-based placeholder is        │
│          placed.                                                             │
│     • Writes updated rows to output_path/refined_masks.csv with updated      │
│       xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, coords_x, coords_y, and type set to polyline.  │
│     • Preserves the first unnamed CSV column in the output.                  │
